data.name: Grim Fate Gift
data.description: Once per day as an immediate action, you can reroll an ability check, attack roll, caster level check, saving throw, or skill check after learning the result.

raw_tokens.value: Once per day as an immediate action, you can reroll an ability check, attack roll, caster level check, saving throw, or skill check after learning the result.

You can also lay a curse of unluck upon a creature (Core Rulebook 557) once per day. This takes a standard action, and must target a creature you can see within 30 feet.|PREVARGTEQ:AccursedManifestationLevel,8
